name: payment-card-preview
title: Payment card preview
description: A payment card drawn live as you fill in the form: number grouped by network, name and expiry, the brand in words, a back for the code, nothing stored.
docs: number, name, expiry, cvc and brand are whatever the form holds right now, complete or not: only digits count, so '4242 4242' and '4242-4242' are the same, and nothing is stored or sent. The brand is found from the first digits (visa, mastercard, amex, discover, diners, jcb, unionpay, maestro) unless you pass brand, which also takes any other text and sets it as it is; the digits group as the network groups them (4-4-4-4, 4-6-5 for American Express, 4-6-4 for Diners Club) and places still to be filled show as soft bullets. masked hides all but the last four digits (and the security code); flipped shows the back with the security code area, turning in 3D or cross-fading under reduced motion. The card is one figure whose accessible name tells what is filled in so far ('Visa card for Ada Lovelace ending 4242, expires 09/28'). The helpers in payment-card-preview/card (detectBrand, brandInfo, formatNumber, formatExpiry, digitsOf) format an input as the person types, which is how the demo uses them. The card scales with its width, so give it one with className. labels holds the fixed words. It keeps no state and renders on the server.
